cv_text:
SARI DEWI — Application Developer, 3 years.
EXPERIENCE: internal tooling in PHP/Laravel and Python; one Go side project deployed for 200 internal users. SQL design experience on MySQL; Docker for local development; no Kubernetes in production.
SKILLS: PHP, MySQL, Python, Go (intermediate), Docker, Git.
report_text:
CASE STUDY: consolidating three duplicate invoice services.
Problem: three teams each owned an invoice writer; 40% of production incidents traced back to inconsistent behaviour between them. I had no authority over the other teams.
Approach: mapped the behavioural differences into a comparison table, then proposed a single service with a compatibility layer. Rejected a big-bang rewrite and instead migrated one caller at a time behind a feature flag, keeping both paths for 3 weeks.
Results: 3 services -> 1, incident share 40% -> 9% over two quarters, 1,200 lines of duplicated code removed. I measured the incident split before and after with the on-call log and shared the numbers with both teams.
